This song is dedicated to  {tag=42b105207c51425292d98b65df108b12} and {tag=89f514e1f0f549778ddc77ef030a8b46}. Sung parody to come out somewhere in the future
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-wypay6lcA[original gary song]

Posighdun, now I know I was wrong
avicus messed up and now you're gone
PieZ, I'm sorry I neglected you
Oh, I never expected you to re-tire
And leave me feeling this empty
Your hello right now would sound like music to me
Please come home 'cause I miss you, PieZ


PieZ, come home
Posighdun, come home
PieZ, come home

Posighdun, can't you see I was blind?
I'll do anything to change your mind
More than an admin, you're my best friend
Too cool to forget, come back 'cause we are family
And forgive me for making you wanna die
And now, my heart is beating like the saddest metronome
Somewhere I hope you're reading my latest feedback post


Posighdun, come home
PieZ, come home
Posighdun, come home
PieZ, come home
Posighdun, come home
PieZ, come home
Posighdun, come home
PieZ, come home
Posighdun, come home
PieZ, come home
Admins, won't you come home?
